pet_notes: Female longhaired bicolor cat from reference photos. Slender body under fluffy ivory white long fur; gray-taupe ears and symmetric eye mask, blue eyes, pink nose, inverted white facial blaze, long gray-taupe feather tail. Shy, tiny voice, furtive sideways glances, quick sprint. Fixed skeletal head/body proportions, no per-frame resizing, no clothes, no accessories, no props. Front three-quarter seated canonical pose.
style_notes: Polished hand-painted 2D animation cel. Clean softly shaded fur masses, fine warm-gray silhouette outlines, readable at 192 pixels, natural feline anatomy, not chibi and not obese.
style_contract: Pet-safe sprite: compact full-body mascot, readable in a 192x208 cell, clear silhouette, simple face, stable palette/materials, and crisp edges for chroma-key extraction. Style `painterly`: Painterly mascot with simplified brush texture, readable forms, stable palette, and enough edge clarity for clean extraction.
